audit_items.proof_trace: PKCE S256 is correctly enforced: `verifyCodeChallenge()` (oauth.ts:68-83) computes sha256(verifier).base64url and compares against the DB-stored challenge. Single-use is enforced by unconditional `delete_authorization_code` at line 83 (before PKCE check), ensuring no code can be replayed regardless of outcome. Both the authorize endpoint (route.ts:40-44) and the consent schema (actions.ts:25, `z.literal('S256')`) prevent any non-S256 challenge from being stored.
